accept.reason: Human acceptance records product judgment but does not own repository mutation.

auto.reason: The selected owning workflow performs any required closeout.

constitution.reason: Constitution changes are governance artifacts and do not update the code map.

deep-research.reason: Research findings and isolated spikes are planning inputs.

design.reason: Design writes design artifacts, not implementation.

do.reason: Do may create or improve reusable project scripts and configuration within the authorized operation scope; generated outputs and playbook metadata alone do not constitute source mutation.

e2e.reason: E2E may change scoped test assets; product behavior and acceptance remain outside its write boundary.

fast.reason: Fast performs a bounded repository change.

implement-teams.reason: Implement Teams changes orchestration only; closeout remains owned by sp-implement.

map-build.reason: Map Build publishes a baseline through its dedicated validation contract.

map-scan.reason: Map Scan produces baseline evidence through its dedicated acceptance contract.

map-update.reason: Map Update is the explicit incremental maintenance entrypoint.

prd-build.reason: PRD reconstruction writes planning artifacts only.

prd-scan.reason: PRD scanning records planning evidence only.

quick.reason: Quick performs a tracked repository change.

review.reason: Review may repair integrated repository behavior.

test-design.reason: Test-design artifacts and material plans are planning-only.

taskstoissues.reason: Issue export does not own repository source mutation.

team.reason: Team runtime operations defer mutation closeout to the owning workflow.
